column2: Every failure below is a defect in the application, not an unstable test. The 21 failures are 7 distinct issues reproducing across the three browsers. Tests assert correct behaviour, so they fail while the defect is open and will pass once it is fixed.

Many filter and search tests pass vacuously: the listing endpoint returns HTTP 500 (BUG-001) so every result set is empty, and an empty-in/empty-out assertion holds. They are marked Blocked rather than Pass in the manual test-case sheet.
